location.home.description: A small patch of land, sparsely dotted with pines and limestone ridges - the perfect place for a home in this desolate world.
location.pineSmall.description: A still clearing dotted with pine trees and a heavy silence only broken by the rustling wind.
location.pineMedium.description: A dense forest filled with pine trees, strong gusts muffling an unsettling murmur in the distance.
location.pineLarge.description: An imposing grove of towering pines, their dense canopy and swirling fog concealing all but faint whispers.
location.bunkerAlfa.description: A dilapidated bunker, its rusting doors and crumbling walls hinting at a recent demise. Though its many floors and thick walls are filled with weapons and supplies, it might be best to leave them alone.
location.bunkerBravo.description: Once a high-security military outpost in the mountain corridor, Bunker Bravo now lies in eerie silence. Rusted metal doors hang ajar, and the flicker of broken lights barely illuminates cracked walls and scattered supplies. Geiger counters click faintly in the shadows, but echoes of past experiments linger stronger than radiation. Venture inside at your own risk.
location.convoy.description: A distant roar cuts through the still air as you receive a distress signal over the radio.
event.convoy.description: A convoy of abandoned vehicles, their rusting frames and shattered glass hinting at an unsettling recent past.
event.raiders.description: An unfamiliar voice crackles over the radio, requesting the location of survivors. Maybe you should listen...
item.leatherBoots.description: A pair of worn leather boots, offering basic protection for your feet. They provide minimal defense against the harsh environment and are not suitable for combat.
item.cloth.description: A piece of cloth, salvaged from old clothing or fabric. It can be used for crafting basic items or as a makeshift bandage in emergencies.
item.ductTape.description: A roll of duct tape, a versatile adhesive that can be used for quick repairs or makeshift solutions. It can temporarily fix broken items or hold things together.
item.ironBar.description: A sturdy iron bar, salvaged from old machinery or structures. It can be used for crafting stronger tools or as a makeshift weapon in desperate situations.
item.ironChunk.description: A chunk of iron ore, mined from the earth. It can be smelted into iron bars or used as a raw material for crafting various items.
item.ironScrap.description: A piece of scrap iron, salvaged from old machinery or structures. It can be used for crafting basic tools or as a component in more complex items.
item.nails.description: A handful of nails, salvaged from old wooden structures. They can be used for crafting or as a component in more complex items.
item.pinePlank.description: A plank of pine wood, cut from a tree. It can be used for crafting basic items or as a building material for structures.
item.rope.description: A length of rope, salvaged from old equipment or natural fibers. It can be used for crafting or as a component in more complex items.
item.steelBar.description: A sturdy steel bar, crafted from iron and carbon. It can be used for crafting stronger tools or as a makeshift weapon in desperate situations.
item.steelScrap.description: A piece of scrap steel, salvaged from old machinery or structures. It can be used for crafting basic tools or as a component in more complex items.
item.ironHatchet.description: A basic hatchet made from iron, suitable for chopping wood and basic crafting tasks. It offers minimal durability and is not ideal for combat.
item.ironPickaxe.description: A basic pickaxe made from iron, suitable for mining and basic crafting tasks. It offers minimal durability and is not ideal for combat.
